summary: Analyzed code-quality.md (720 lines, ~2,880 tokens) for documentation efficiency. Identified 53% token reduction opportunity (→1,360 tokens) through base pattern duplication removal (720 tokens), workflow externalization (600 tokens), and Quick Reference addition. Progressive Disclosure Grade improves from D (66.8%) to B (82.3%). Primary issues: duplicated Pre-Flight Checklist (lines 118-154), inline verbose workflow (lines 203-554), missing Quick Reference. Recommendations prioritized by value score: P1-1 (136.8), P1-2 (17.6), P2-3 (9.0).
